key_notes: Key 1 (t=1.73s): Initial archival pose of nail; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.
Key 2 (t=2.85s): Mid-sequence articulation of nail; 2x2 smooth cage tracks primary motion.
Key 3 (t=4.09s): Peak dynamic extension of nail over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=5.33s): Follow-through and settle of nail with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of nail (1.73s..5.33s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
